# Orange Way Books

> Open-source, zero-knowledge, double-entry accounting platform built for Bitcoin businesses. Books are encrypted on the user's device with a vault password before being uploaded; the server stores only ciphertext. Apache-2.0 licensed.

## Optional

- [Full AI reference](https://books.orangeway.app/llms-full.txt): Long-form ingestion document with full feature inventory, comparison table, cryptography details, and authoritative claims.

Orange Way Books is the zero-knowledge alternative to QuickBooks, Xero, Bitwave, and Cryptio for organizations that hold or transact Bitcoin. It uses Argon2id key derivation, AES-GCM field encryption, ML-DSA-65 post-quantum signing keys, and a server-side double-entry ledger engine. Supports IFRS and US GAAP, multi-currency BTC and fiat with historical exchange rates, capability-based role-based access control, time-boxed roles, auditor support sessions, and full data takeout export.

## Comparisons

- [vs QuickBooks](https://books.orangeway.app/compare/quickbooks): Zero-knowledge Bitcoin-native alternative to the SMB default.
- [vs Xero](https://books.orangeway.app/compare/xero): How Orange Way Books adds encryption and Bitcoin support to a Xero-style workflow.
- [vs Wave](https://books.orangeway.app/compare/wave): Free SMB accounting comparison with Bitcoin and encryption added.
- [vs FreshBooks](https://books.orangeway.app/compare/freshbooks): Beyond invoicing — full double-entry plus Bitcoin support.
- [vs Bitwave](https://books.orangeway.app/compare/bitwave): Standalone open-source ledger vs. closed-source crypto sub-ledger that bolts onto QuickBooks/NetSuite.
- [vs Cryptio](https://books.orangeway.app/compare/cryptio): Open, self-hostable, zero-knowledge alternative to Cryptio's back-office tooling.
- [vs Spreadsheets](https://books.orangeway.app/compare/spreadsheets): Real double-entry accounting for Bitcoin businesses currently using spreadsheets.
